entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 108:1-13 . This Psalm is composed of Ps 108:1-5 of Ps 57:7-11 ; and Ps 108:6-12 of Ps 60:5-12 . The varieties are verbal and trivial, except that in Ps 108:9 , "over Philistia will I triumph," differs from Ps 60:8 , the interpretation of which it confirms. Its altogether triumphant tone may intimate that it was prepared by David, omitting the plaintive portions of the other Psalms, as commemorative of God's favor in the victories of His people.
